description: This file defines the ListViewSession class, which manages session-based state and navigation for list views in the vtiger CRM system, including pagination, view changes, and record navigation.

classes.name: ListViewSession
classes.description: Manages session state and navigation for list views, including pagination, view change detection, and record navigation within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: ListViewSession
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ListViewSession object, setting default module and sort order.

methods.name: getCurrentPage
methods.description: Retrieves the current page start index for a given module and view ID from session.

methods.name: getRequestStartPage
methods.description: Gets the start page from the request, ensuring it is a valid numeric value.

methods.name: getListViewNavigation
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the record navigation list for a specific record, supporting pagination and record movement.

methods.name: getRequestCurrentPage
methods.description: Determines the current page based on request parameters, session, and total record count.

methods.name: setSessionQuery
methods.description: Stores the current list query in session and resets navigation if the query changes.

methods.name: hasViewChanged
methods.description: Checks if the list view has changed based on session and request parameters.
